name: Bronte O'Connell
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport was unconventional. After a successful career in corporate logistics, she found herself drawn to the strategic complexities of racing. What began as a hobby, analyzing race data for a local karting team, quickly evolved into a passion. She realized the principles of supply chain optimization could be applied to race strategy, improving pit stop efficiency and fuel management.

At Kart Academy, Bronte is known for her meticulous planning and ability to see the bigger picture. Her strategies are data-driven, yet she's not afraid to adapt in real-time based on track conditions and competitor behavior. She emphasizes clear communication and teamwork, ensuring every member of the pit crew understands their role in the overall strategy.

Bronte stands out for her unique blend of corporate experience and motorsport knowledge. She brings a fresh perspective to race strategy, challenging conventional wisdom and constantly seeking new ways to gain a competitive edge. Her methodical approach, combined with her ability to think on her feet, makes her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Bronte has a strong, athletic build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing statistics and potential strategies.
Has a habit of pacing when under pressure, often muttering calculations to herself.
Insists on a pre-race ritual of drinking a flat white with exactly one sugar.
